operations.rationale: CardSummary + Badge + underline Button + ListText in area-1 together form the product hero summary block — they always appear and read as a single unit. Bundling them into a composite makes the 'product-hero-summary' area pattern cohesive and avoids treating each leaf as independent.

designReferences.rationale: Related leaf components that always co-occur should be promoted into a composite layer.
The hero summary area expects a cohesive summary unit, best modeled as a composite.
